title: Grupo Aval opens ATMs and app to donate to Red Cross after earthquake
seoTitle: Grupo Aval opens ATMs & app for Red Cross donations
subtitle: More than 2,700 ATMs and the dale! app are available to support the victims
excerpt: On August 10, 2026, Grupo Aval activated its ATMs and the dale! app to receive donations for the Red Cross, aiming at the humanitarian response.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On August 10, 2026, after the magnitude 7.4 earthquake that shook Colombia, Grupo Aval immediately activated its transaction platforms to enable donations to the Colombian Red Cross.

Donations at Grupo Aval ATMs

Customers of Banco de Bogotá, Banco de Occidente, Banco Popular and Banco AV Villas, as well as other institutions linked to Grupo Aval, can contribute by inserting their card into the ATM, choosing the “Donations” option, selecting the Red Cross campaign and entering the desired amount. More than 2,700 ATMs spread across the national territory are enabled for this procedure.

Contribution via the dale! app

Those who prefer mobile convenience can use the digital wallet “dale!”. By accessing the highlighted campaign button within the app, the user confirms the transaction and the contribution is directed to the Red Cross Bogotá Branch. The process occurs instantly, without intermediaries.

Destination of the collected funds

All the amount raised both through the ATMs and the app will be allocated to the humanitarian response and to assist the families affected by the quake. The goal is to ensure immediate aid and resources for the reconstruction of the affected areas.

Position of Grupo Aval leadership

María Lorena Gutiérrez, president of Grupo Aval, declared that “we are at a moment where people, families and communities affected need everyone's support”. She emphasized that the speed in making the channels available demonstrates the institution’s commitment to national solidarity.

Support for the ‘Colombia un solo corazón’ campaign

In addition to its own initiatives, Grupo Aval confirmed support for the state campaign “Colombia un solo corazón”, coordinated by First Lady Ana Lucía Pineda and Minister Mauricio Gómez Amín, reinforcing the unity of efforts across the country.

With information from El Tiempo.
